mapper.select: SELECT a.id as id, b.password as password, c.max_contacts as max_contacts, a.context as context, a.transport as transport, a.allow as allow, COALESCE(d.record_yn, 'Y') as record_yn, a.callerid as callerid, d.mobile_no as mobile_no, d.routing_mode as routing_mode, d.status as status, d.duty_yn as duty_yn FROM ps_endpoints a LEFT JOIN ps_auths b ON a.id = b.id LEFT JOIN ps_aors c ON a.id = c.id LEFT JOIN ps_endpoints_custom d ON a.id = d.id WHERE 1=1 AND a.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{id}, '%') AND a.callerid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{callerid}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ps_aors (id, max_contacts, remove_existing) VALUES (#{id}, COALESCE(#{max_contacts}, 1), 'yes') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE max_contacts = COALESCE(#{max_contacts}, 1)

-- 1) Asterisk Core Standard Table INSERT INTO ps_endpoints (id, transport, aors, auth, context, disallow, allow, callerid, force_rport, rewrite_contact, rtp_symmetric, direct_media, rtp_timeout, timers) VALUES (#{id}, #{transport}, #{id}, #{id}, #{context}, 'all', #{allow}, #{callerid}, 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no', 20, 'yes') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transport = #{transport}, context = #{context}, allow = #{allow}, callerid = #{callerid};
-- 2) ERP Custom Business Table INSERT INTO ps_endpoints_custom (id, record_yn, mobile_no, routing_mode, status, duty_yn) VALUES (#{id}, COALESCE(#{record_yn}, 'Y'), #{mobile_no}, COALESCE(#{routing_mode}, '10'), COALESCE(#{status}, '10'), COALESCE(#{duty_yn}, 'N')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE record_yn = COALESCE(#{record_yn}, 'Y'), mobile_no = #{mobile_no}, routing_mode = COALESCE(#{routing_mode}, '10'), status = COALESCE(#{status}, '10'), duty_yn = COALESCE(#{duty_yn}, 'N');
mapper.select: SELECT name, musiconhold, strategy, timeout, ringinuse, context FROM queues WHERE 1=1 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT REPLACE(interface, 'PJSIP/', '') as interface_no, membername as membername, penalty as penalty, paused as paused, wrapuptime as wrapuptime FROM queue_members WHERE queue_name = #{queue_name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO queues (name, musiconhold, strategy, timeout, ringinuse, context, failover_dest) VALUES (#{name}, COALESCE(#{musiconhold}, 'default'), #{strategy}, #{timeout}, #{ringinuse}, #{context}, #{failover_dest}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE musiconhold = COALESCE(#{musiconhold}, 'default'), strategy = #{strategy}, timeout = #{timeout}, failover_dest = #{failover_dest}

INSERT INTO queue_members (queue_name, interface, membername, penalty, paused, wrapuptime) VALUES (#{queue_name}, CONCAT('PJSIP/', #{interface_no}), #{membername}, #{penalty}, #{paused}, #{wrapuptime})
mapper.select: SELECT context, exten, priority, app, appdata FROM extensions WHERE 1=1 AND context LIKE CONCAT('%', #{context}, '%') AND exten LIKE CONCAT('%', #{exten}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extensions (context, exten, priority, app, appdata) VALUES (#{context}, #{exten}, #{priority}, #{app}, #{appdata})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM extensions WHERE context = #{context} AND exten = #{exten}
mapper.select: SELECT id, description, script_text, upd_user, upd_dtime FROM ars_scripts WHERE 1=1 AND id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{id}, '%') ORDER BY id ASC
